# Mike Elmasian

> Product leader based in Austin, TX with 10+ years specializing in product-led growth (PLG) and self-serve motions in B2B software. Currently at Clio (legal AI).

Also known as Michael Elmasian. This is his personal site and digital resume.

## Experience

- Clio (legal AI): delivered more than 2x the ARR originally sized for product-led growth influenced revenue in 2026. Built multi-product cross-sell and targeted expansion moments, and brought legal AI to market as a primary customer acquisition motion.
- Sana Benefits and Maxwell Health (health benefits; Maxwell acquired by Sun Life in 2018): joined both as early-stage startups and built PLG motions from scratch. At Sana, built the self-serve acquisition funnel and automated the onboarding and renewal flows. At Maxwell, led an experimentation team and a new product launch.
- Fidelity: led growth on Fidelity's third largest trading platform. Built a PQL scoring system for financial advisors and RIAs to drive adoption of a freemium tool suite he owned.

## Topics he writes about

- Product-led growth: self-serve motions, activation, PQL frameworks, pricing and packaging
- Opportunity sizing: comparing churn fixes, acquisition channels and engagement plays on one scale
- AI for product managers, and PLG for AI products
